faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Scottish Terrier?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 18-22 lb (8-10 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Scottish Terrier?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Bladder cancer risk; Craniomandibular osteopathy risk; Von Willebrand risk. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Scottish Terrier at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Scottish Terrier default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
